name: updated-again
description: A living software toy that updates because updating is the point. 每天至少一更。

paragraphs: A living software toy that changes something every day, because updating is the point.
Play online · Release ledger · Suggest an update · 简体中文
It updates itself. The reason can be “the author felt like it”; the change must be real, verifiable, installable, and reversible.
features: Circuit Room: daily puzzles, historical replay, seven-round weekly challenges, and free practice on 3×3, 4×4, and 5×5 boards. Each puzzle saves separately. Undo, shortest-solution hints, independent scores, share links,…
Patch Mixer: turn installed changes into 84 collectible experiments, with daily clues and a local notebook.
Focused navigation: Play, Today, Archive, and About have separate pages. One toy is shown at a time; the board, records, and controls retain a consistent layout.

Four interface languages: English by default, plus Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Spanish. Use the header selector; your choice stays on this device. Switching languages keeps puzzle progress and records.

Local play calendar: daily puzzles, weekly challenges, and displayed timestamps follow your device's local time. New public releases and automated health audits use UTC. Original signed release text and historical…
